svg.title: Hi, I’m Dev Psalmist
svg.desc: Faded psalm street-art behind the intro. Python, Java Developer | Backend & Frontend Builder | with little explorative work with AI Explorer | Problem Solver. I’m a developer who turns a requirement into a working system: backend APIs, less AI-assisted tools, and interfaces that turn messy information into something you can act on. Most of my work is in Python, C++ and TypeScript, and I care about clear structure, tests that check something real, and code the next person can pick up.
